title: Ledgerflow
description: Multi-tenant invoicing platform for B2B finance teams. Built with Next.js App Router, Prisma, and Stripe billing so invoices, dunning, and tenant isolation stay in one system.
architecture: App Router + Server Actions, Prisma on PostgreSQL, Stripe webhooks via Route Handlers, background jobs for dunning, Vercel + GitHub Actions CI.

title: Tracekit
description: Internal error and latency dashboard. An Express ingest API writes structured events to MongoDB, and a Next.js frontend queries aggregated traces with live filters.
architecture: Node/Express ingest service, MongoDB time-series collections, Next.js App Router dashboard, Docker Compose for local parity with production.

title: OrbitAuth
description: Session-based auth service with email magic links and org RBAC. Next.js API Routes issue httpOnly cookies while Prisma models users, orgs, and memberships.
architecture: Next.js API Routes, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Redis-backed rate limits, AWS SES for mail, GitHub Actions → Docker image → ECS.

title: Harborboard
description: Project tracker with realtime presence. React Query on the frontend, Server Actions for CRUD, and a lightweight Node websocket gateway so board state stays consistent.
architecture: Next.js + React, Server Actions, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Node websocket gateway, deployed on Vercel with the socket service on a Docker host.
